description: In a new video today, Democratic nominee for governor Cindy Holscher is highlighting the Marple family, who have raised serious concerns about a proposed 10-building data center complex threatening their family farm. The Marples are lifelong Republicans, but they are supporting Cindy Holscher because she’s the only candidate for governor taking data center concerns seriously.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Cindy Holscher for Kansas
title: Holscher launches new webisode on data centers with lifelong Republicans | Cindy Holscher for Governor
